mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at 66 degrees at Verona Community Park. We are expecting an overnight low of 61 degrees with rain on the way. If you look toward the northwest near the high school at 8:27 PM, you can spot the International Space Station as it travels toward the northeast near Home Depot over the next four minutes.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance begins September 23 on various streets, including Cross Country Road and the East Verona Avenue area. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting October 5 to review several development projects, including site plans for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do this week. Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli or head to the Dane County Farmers Market. On September 20, Bike the Barns takes place at Badger Prairie County Park.
In our weekly update, on September 10, officers arrested a 19-year-old male for burglary and recklessly endangering safety after he broke into a building on Hunters Cove Way and a gunshot was heard.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available while the crew works on the shop.
